title: oxalis stolonifera
intro: Oxalis stolonifera, commonly known as the creeping wood sorrel, is a perennial plant species in the Oxalidaceae family. This plant is known for its edible and medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, as well as potential anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis stolonifera include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
